stepNotes.1: Account is the OAuth device-code identity service (Account.create Interface, index.ts:254) over two Drizzle tables; all HTTP bodies are Zod-validated and at-rest encryption is delegated to auth/encryption.ts.
stepNotes.2: Primary asset is the persisted access/refresh token ciphertext; key threats are silent install-secret key downgrade, legacy plaintext acceptance, caller-supplied server URL trust, and concurrent-refresh token invalidation (mitigated by the tokenRefreshes singleton map).
stepNotes.3: Refresh-singleton and allSettled-drop invariants hold; schema validation and error translation (AccountRepoError/AccountServiceError) are consistent; legacy plaintext path is the documented invariant relaxation now made observable.
stepNotes.4: Startup decryption cost is bounded by encryption.ts keyCache (512) and v2 10k iterations; no unbounded maps (tokenRefreshes drained on completion) and no N+1 (allSettled fan-out); no perf finding.
stepNotes.5: Clean schema/repo/service split along policy vs IO; the bare-function singleton re-export (export let) and the auth-cross-boundary are deliberate; ControlAccountTable is a retained legacy table.
stepNotes.6: ControlAccountTable is exported and re-exported but has zero query references (grep-confirmed) — migration/doc note, not a defect; no TODO/empty-catch in the four files.
stepNotes.7: repo/service/token-decode/cli tests plus the cross-module encryption regression cover the fixes; gaps are dedicated concurrency tests for refresh dedup, the still-valid-token fallback, and orgsByAccount allSettled drop.
stepNotes.8: AUDIT-account-001 (Medium) and AUDIT-account-002 (Low) both verified-fixed by codex-sol; no new Critical/High found; remaining items are hygiene/test-gap notes only.
stepNotes.9: Targeted vitest runs for account/* and auth/encryption plus core typecheck are the proof; full suites intentionally skipped per README (root pnpm test fails by design).
